verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment noting that GitHub plans include package storage (2GB on Team vs. 500MB on Free). That implies GitHub hosts packages for private repos, but nothing documents publishing or consuming them, the supported formats, or container images. missing for 10: first-party docs on a package registry, evidence of npm/PyPI/Maven format support, container image hosting, public vs. private package visibility controls, and the publish/consume workflow (e.g., via Actions or the CLI).
